name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
summary_text: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha: own legal system; decriminalised; remote, church-conservative. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.06. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: LGBT rights in Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha - Alchetron, the free social encyclopedia
sources.claim_summary: Alchetron (Wikipedia-derived): LGBT rights in Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha - same-sex activity legal; the 2009 Constitution Order bans sexual-orientation discrimination; same-sex marriage legal on Ascension since 1 Jan 2017, with Tristan da Cunha following; Saint Helena did not then recognise same-sex unions.

sources.title: GayLawNet®™ | Laws | St Helena | Ascension Island | Tristan da Cunha | SH
sources.claim_summary: GayLawNet laws page for Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha: equal age of consent at 16; the 2009 Constitution Order Section 5 guarantees fundamental rights 'without distinction of any kind, such as sex, sexual orientation...'; territory-level legal references.

Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror): LGBTQ rights in Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha - discrimination banned territory-wide since 2009; same-sex marriage legal since 2017 (Ascension 1 Jan, Tristan da Cunha 4 Aug, Saint Helena 20 Dec); adoption since 2017; detailed vote records of the Ascension Island Council (5-0).

Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror, redirects to the territory article): LGBTQ rights on Ascension Island - the marriage ordinance approved 31 May 2016 (5-0), signed and gazetted 20 June, commenced 1 January 2017.
